t: NixOS Declarative Fix for 403 Errors & Jekyll Theme Streamlining
s: Resolves persistent 403 permission errors on a NixOS server by declaratively configuring user home directory permissions and streamlines Jekyll themes for a content-first aesthetic, preparing for public deployment.
sub: Declarative NixOS configuration for persistent 403 error resolution
Jekyll theme streamlining for minimalist aesthetic
Dynamic DNS synchronization for home-hosted services
